description: Commit this site to a specific visual direction, and apply it (fonts, type roles, palette swatches). Call this ONCE, BEFORE generating a new site's first page — a site with no committed direction has nothing for later edits to stay consistent with, and the result drifts to generic. Prefer a `directionId` from the sampled menu; supply the `custom` fields only when the user's brief clearly calls for something the menu doesn't cover. Not needed when editing a site that already has a direction.

custom.description: A direction you authored, when no menu entry fits the brief. Must be as specific as a menu entry — a face with actual character, a real palette, a named signature move.

accentFamily.description: Tailwind family the brand primary ramp derives from (e.g. orange, teal, indigo).

displayFace.description: Optional Google Fonts family for headings. Omit for a deliberate single-face direction.

displaySlot.description: Which family slot the display face occupies. Required when `displayFace` is set.

headingFont.description: Route h1-h6 onto a slot site-wide. Omit to keep headings on the primary face and opt in per element with `font-serif`.

id.description: Short kebab-case slug naming the direction.

mode.description: What visitor success looks like: persuade (decide + act), operate (complete a task), read (understand), experience (the work itself leads).

neutralFamily.description: Tailwind family for surfaces and ink (e.g. stone, zinc, slate, gray, neutral).

notLike.description: The nearby cliché this must not collapse into.

primaryFace.description: Google Fonts family for body/UI. Must have character — never Geist, Inter, Roboto, Arial, Helvetica or system-ui.

signatureMove.description: The one thing a visitor would remember.

swatches.description: Base Colors swatch literals keyed by token, e.g. { "color-stone-50": "#FAF6EF" }. This is what makes the palette specific rather than a stock Tailwind ramp — supply at least three.

topology.description: How the page is organized. Concrete enough to drive section rhythm, not a mood word.

directionId.description: Id of a direction from the sampled menu (e.g. 'oat-editorial'). Preferred over `custom`.

name: swebsy_commit_design_direction
